prompt:
Architectural floor plan of one room, drawn straight from above as a clean top-down orthographic plan view in the style of a set designer's ground plan: white background, thick dark walls with gaps for doors and windows, door swings drawn as arcs, windows as thin double lines, and every piece of furniture as a simple outline from above, to scale. In the plan, its bottom edge is the front wall, its top edge the back wall, its left edge the left wall and its right edge the right wall, as the establishing view names them. Draw only the doors, windows and openings the description names. Location: SU YAQING'S DINING AREA. Elegant dining nook in the same luxury apartment. A round white marble table holds a vase of daisies and a wine bottle, with upholstered dining chairs around it. A chair beside it stands by a tall window. Soft daylight comes through the window from the side, and a modern brass pendant lamp hangs above the table.

Avoid: people, text, labels, numbers, letters, dimensions, compass, logos, watermark, a door or window the description does not name.
